ai.title: Add cloud handoff and thread digest contracts to common package
ai.summary: New modules in `common/src/desktop-cloud/` define the wire contract for moving a Cloud chat to a local computer and the shared shape for a project coordinator's thread panel. The handoff module specifies API headers for exporting chat worktrees and error messages for fencing chats to prevent concurrent execution. The threads module introduces a unified `ThreadDigest` schema with group and status line logic for both local and cloud threads. A new `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_UNCAPPED_TAB_LIMIT` constant and `desktopTabCapExempt` wire field allow exempt accounts to bypass standard tab caps.

eli5.text: The shared instructions now define how a cloud-based coding chat moves to your computer and how a coordinator organizes multiple AI work tasks. The system includes safety rules to prevent the same chat from running on two devices at once and provides a clear layout that tells you which tasks need your attention, are working, are done, or are waiting for you. This internal structure prepares the interface for these coordination features, but the actual screens and server actions that let you use them are not included in this update yet. Ordinary users will not notice any change in their daily coding sessions until those other parts are added.

entries.title: CLI update: use-freebuff-chat-admission

ai.title: CLI model selection follows Balanced stop when no explicit pick
ai.summary: The CLI model selection logic now defaults to the 'balanced' model preset (such as DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) for accounts without an explicit pick, rather than retaining the static default. This is driven by a new `freebuffDefaultModelForSession` helper in `cli/src/state/freebuff-model-store.ts` that resolves the balanced preset and falls back to the catalog's recommended model if the Freebucks meter cannot start it. The `hasExplicitPick` flag in the model store tracks whether the user has made a deliberate selection, preventing automatic defaulting once a pick has been registered. This mechanism ensures that a send before the first session response uses the dynamically resolved default, aligning the CLI's initial model choice with the Desktop and Web slider's balanced stop.
ai.evidence: In `cli/src/state/freebuff-model-store.ts`, the new `freebuffDefaultModelForSession` function resolves the 'balanced' model preset and falls back to the catalog's `recommendedModelId` when the meter cannot start it; in `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts`, the `resolveFreebuffModelSelectionForSession` function now accepts a `hasExplicitPick` parameter and returns `freebuffDefaultModelForSession(session)` when the session status is 'none' and the flag is false.

changes.what: Added `freebuffDefaultModelForSession` to resolve the balanced model preset with a fallback to the catalog's recommended model when the meter is exhausted.
Updated `resolveFreebuffModelSelectionForSession` to accept `hasExplicitPick` and default to `freebuffDefaultModelForSession` when no explicit pick is present.
Modified the admission gate to use the `hasExplicitPick` flag to determine whether to use the captured admission model or the current dynamically resolved selection.
Updated the documentation comment for `DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` to clarify it serves as the selection for new CLI users until a session response moves it to the balanced stop.

eli5.text: When you start a new conversation in the terminal assistant without first picking a specific AI model, the system now automatically selects the same balanced option that the desktop and web apps default to, rather than sticking to an older static choice. If your account does not have enough credits to start that preferred model, the system steps down to a simpler recommended model so your request still goes through. This applies to anyone using the free terminal tool who has not manually saved a model preference; those who have picked a specific model will continue to use their chosen option as before. This small internal update ensures the terminal matches the default behavior of other platforms when you just hit send without choosing a model.
